annotations.text:
RULED PAPER. Newsreader serif on warm paper, cards as index cards with a coloured margin rule. Difficulty is filled/hollow squares plus the word, so it survives greyscale.
Row 1 — getting started: empty, notes pasted, free preview estimate.
Row 2 — the run: staged progress with cards arriving underneath, the results grid, and one card opened. Answers are clamped to two lines by default so a dozen cards stay scannable; Reveal opens them.
Row 3 — failure and narrow. Errors sit where the results would be, so the notes and any cards already generated stay on screen. Narrow is the same page below 900px.
